title: Angular Router
description: The official router for Angular applications with powerful navigation features.

data.text: Angular Router is the official routing library for Angular. It enables navigation between views, supports lazy loading of feature modules, route guards for authentication, and resolvers for pre-fetching data.

data.title: Route Configuration

terms.definition: Loading feature modules only when the user navigates to their routes.
An interface that controls access to routes, commonly used for authentication.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Angular Router supports lazy loading and guards
Uses route configuration with path-component mapping
data.takeaway: Angular Router provides a robust, feature-rich routing solution for Angular apps.
